method: Grid-stratified sampling: CORE bbox divided into 5x5 cells; per cell, drivable degree>=1 graph nodes with a baseline path to a mapped facility are shuffled with seed 20261010 and the first 4 are kept.
regression_note: The original six Phase 0/1 origins (data/origins_snapped.csv) are preserved separately and are NOT part of this sample.
interpretation_note: These are geographic sampling points on the road network, NOT population-weighted demand points and NOT actual patient locations.
